definitions.explanation: The act of sending something back, typically packages or documents, to the sender or a specified location.

examples.japanese: {不良品|ふりょうひん}を{返送|へんそう}した。
examples.english: I sent back the defective product.

examples.japanese: {返送|へんそう}{料|りょう}は{当社|とうしゃ}{負担|ふたん}です。
examples.english: Our company will cover the return shipping cost.

examples.japanese: {書類|しょるい}に{記入|きにゅう}して{返送|へんそう}してください。
examples.english: Please fill out the documents and send them back.

examples.japanese: {返送|へんそう}は{着払|ちゃくばら}いでお{願|ねが}いします。
examples.english: Please send it back with postage due.

examples.japanese: {商品|しょうひん}に{問題|もんだい}がある{場合|ばあい}は、{一週間|いっしゅうかん}{以内|いない}に{返送|へんそう}していただければ{交換|こうかん}いたします。
examples.english: If there is a problem with the product, we will exchange it if you send it back within one week.

notes:
{返送|へんそう} specifically means sending something back to where it came from — packages, documents, or merchandise. It is a する verb: {返送|へんそう}する.

FORMS:
{返|へん} (return) + {送|そう} (send)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {返送|へんそう}{料|りょう} / {返送|へんそう}{費用|ひよう} (return shipping cost)
- {着払|ちゃくばら}いで{返送|へんそう}する (to return with postage due)
- {元払|もとばら}いで{返送|へんそう}する (to return prepaid)
- {返送|へんそう}{先|さき} (return address / destination)

RELATED WORDS:
- {送付|そうふ}: sending (forward direction)
- {返品|へんぴん}: product return (returning merchandise specifically)
- {送|おく}り{返|かえ}す: to send back (native Japanese equivalent, less formal)

REGISTER:
Used in formal and business contexts — customer service, official correspondence, and shipping instructions.
